notes.title: Demo patch notes - 0.7.7
notes.notes:
Patch notes - 0.7.7

More Input Hints

Weapon stats ATK / DMG or DEF for equipped items now visible in character menu

Make damage when no weapon is equipped

All items are now sellable at the different merchants

Started with switching to flat item & skill sprites

Localised input hints

Only one battle can be active 

Save game & continue game for demo 

Fixed feedback tool cancel button

Current HP cannot be higher than MaxHP

Fixed some bullet hell attacks

A big thank you to everyone who gave feedback!



Know bug - Sometimes the music is not played during or after battles

notes.title: A Massive Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



With the Tiny Teams Event starting soon and Crystals of Irm being a part of that, we thought it'd be about time to give you all a massive PLAYABLE update. So here we are, announcing an all new Demo. A new Trailer is also in the works but that'll take slightly longer. Wished it was ready for today but hey, Gamescom is ahead so that's another chance, right?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/b7a2c356e4bc02c10c16b792cabb1e3bacc4e385.jpg"]

What's new in the demo? Well. Uhm. Everything? If you ever played an earlier iteration of Crystals of Irm you should completely wipe out that experience from your memory. We've been working on literally everything. While it is still the same game, it plays, feels and even looks different now. The style is the same but everything has been tuned, upgraded and tuned even further.

From UI to Combat, from visuals to controls (they are not yet fully done though), from pixels to progression. Everything. Just literally everything has been worked on. And finally the project is in a state where we are very happy with it and from where we can now focus on creating more content and fill up the world with monsters, dungeons and NPCs.



So long!

notes.title: Crystals Of Irm Demo Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:
Hey and Hello! 

First of all, sorry for the inconvenience and bugs in the demo version of Crystals Of Irm. I always try to fix them as soon as possible!

Here comes a small list of fixes that are live with version 0.3.1.


  Fixed broken doors in all dungeon levels
  improved damage calculation in battles
  fixed dungeon map reset per level


If you want to give feedback on the demo, feel free to visit the Discord server. Click on the image to start.

notes.title: December Update 2022
notes.notes:
Hey & Hello!


And already it is December again. That was a fast one. You probably guessed it and how could it be otherwise, a lot has happened at Crystals Of Irm. We have really achieved a lot this year and I am already looking forward to 2023. In February there will be a small (actually very big) surprise and I am already so excited. But first things first - the last BlogPost of the year.

What else happened this year? Recently Crystals Of Irm was voted among the TOP100 upcoming Indie Games on IndieDB. How great and a thousand thanks to all who voted for it.

IndieDB - Indie of the Year awards TOP 100


It sounds great! The soundtrack of the game is taking more and more shape and Irm already sounds absolutely wonderful. Just listen to the main theme... It's awesome! Responsible for this great work is the good Fauni. At this point I recommend you to have a look at his site.

Fauni Soundcloud

It looks great! Maybe you already noticed the great promo art of Crystals Of Irm. The incredibly talented Saboowas responsible for that. She managed to fill the character with life and I couldn't be happier with the result. Be sure to check out her work as well.

Sabbi Tabbi Tumblr

It's playable! Dungeon, villages and demons (ok, not really those) - but things can be explored in Irm now. And I'm working on an extra version for you, so you can finally take a first look into the world of Irm. And it really won't take long this time, I promise. February 2023 will be great and very very exciting. Keep your eyes open.

At this point I could tell you a thousand little things. Things like - the dungeons are completely reworked, the enemies got a make over or there is now an extra section in Irm - just for you to test. But so shortly before the vacation and the celebration I spare you all these details and would suggest that we see each other again at this point in the new year.

Once again, thank you to everyone who supports and believes in me on this project. It really means the world to me and as always, I can't wait for the next steps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3145fb638789fd7f8487b6031e98c6c661d74a3d.png

See you next year - Take care

David
